evaluation: frozen out-of-fold checkpoints; no retraining or test-dependent channel selection
negative_proxy: neutral carbon atoms whose heavy-atom neighbours are all carbon
secondary_proxy: negative RDKit Wildman-Crippen atomic logP contribution
channel_orientation: sign of mean full-minus-channel-removed prediction on training molecules only; auxiliary control additionally evaluated with prespecified [-1,+1]
mask_score: sum of channel-sign times node mask divided by its within-molecule channel mean
chemical_metrics: within-molecule Spearman against negative atomic logP
controls: one parameter-randomized model per fold with seed 1042+fold
bootstrap_unit: Bemis-Murcko scaffold clusters, including the shared empty scaffold
deletion: remove selected atoms' contributions at final weighted pooling; keep molecular graph and encoder fixed
scope: node masks; edge masks exported for audit, not independently chemically validated
interpretation: exploratory heuristic agreement and readout faithfulness; no chemical causality or ground-truth attribution accuracy claims
